title: Non-anchor position period prediction v8
rationale: This lane predeclares a position-period structure before scoring any new evidence. It does not use public anchor-derived additive fragments, candidate words, routes, or prior key-material scores as discovery inputs or primary evidence.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared residue classes from the registered period set before any public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Predeclared structural period rule selected before observation scoring
No candidate words, key material, or routes
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
Observation records validated against registered source provenance before scoring
controls: seeded shuffle baseline over observed non-anchor positions
multiple-comparison correction across registered period hypotheses
archive validation requiring preregistration, artifact, observations, command, and result consistency
